## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if applicable.

## Changes

- Describe the final implementation and its scope.

## Validation

List checks actually run, their results, and tested operating systems. Identify relevant checks or
platforms not tested and explain why. For documentation-only changes, report link, language, and
whitespace checks.

## Documentation

List documentation updated with this change. If no update is needed, explain why.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for UI changes, or remove this section when irrelevant.

## Limitations

Describe material limitations or remaining work, or remove this section when irrelevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] Project-authored content, commit messages, and this PR are in English.
- [ ] The base branch matches the documented workflow.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated or the reason is explained above.
- [ ] Validation results describe checks that actually ran.
